comparisons.peer_topic: Goodwill impairment triggers and recent results
comparisons.peer_summary: Changes in operating plans, business conditions, or macroeconomic environment could reduce cash flow estimates and trigger future goodwill impairment charges; however, the annual qualitative test concluded it is not more likely than not that carrying value exceeded fair value for any reporting unit.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AMD disclose the results of their annual goodwill impairment qualitative assessments for fiscal year 2024, concluding that no impairment was required. MU states it performed a qualitative assessment in the current year and identified no impairment indicators, whereas AMD concluded based on its annual qualitative test that it is not more likely than not that the carrying value of any reporting unit exceeded its fair value. Both companies rely on this qualitative first step to avoid quantitative testing in the current period.

sentences.text: We performed a qualitative assessment for the current year and have not identified any impairment indicators for our reporting units.
Based on our annual qualitative impairment test, we concluded it is not more likely than not that the carrying value of each reporting unit exceeded its fair value.

comparisons.peer_summary: Goodwill impairment is assessed annually or when indicators exist using a qualitative first step; factors considered include adverse economic trends, company-specific actions, financial performance deterioration, or sustained market capitalization decreases below net book value.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AVGO describe a similar two-step goodwill impairment methodology starting with an annual qualitative assessment in the fourth quarter. MU tests goodwill in its fourth quarter and performs a qualitative assessment to determine if indicators exist, while AVGO also performs an annual review in the fourth fiscal quarter using qualitative factors to determine if it is more likely than not that fair value is less than carrying amount. Both frameworks allow skipping further quantitative assessment if the qualitative threshold is met.

sentences.text: Goodwill: We test goodwill for impairment in our fourth quarter each year, or more frequently if indicators of an impairment exist, to determine whether it is more likely than not that the fair value of the reporting unit with goodwill is less than its carrying value.
We performed a qualitative assessment for the current year and have not identified any impairment indicators for our reporting units.
We perform an annual impairment review of our goodwill during the fourth fiscal quarter of each year, and more frequently if we believe indicators of impairment exist.

After assessing the totality of events and circumstances, if we determine that it is not more likely than not that the fair value of any of our reporting units is less than its carrying amount, no further assessment is performed.
